egg.plant is a fast-casual vegetarian restaurant serving modern, flavourful vegetarian bowls. Based in Singapore’s business district, we create hearty, wholesome meals built around ingredients we love - eggs, tofu, eggplant, mushrooms, and fresh vegetables.

Our menu is fully vegetarian and allium-free, thoughtfully crafted for busy professionals who want convenience without compromising on taste. With balanced proteins and bold flavours, every bowl is designed to energise your day.

egg.plant - Forward flavours, freshly powered.
